templates.narrative: Granted {days} days Study Leave from {leave_from} to {leave_to} for acquiring the qualification {qualification} having mandatory service period of {liab_years} years & {liab_months} months.

slots.label: First day of leave
slots.help: The first day of the leave itself, not counting any prefix.

slots.label: Last day of leave
slots.help: The last day of the leave itself, not counting any suffix.

slots.label: Days
slots.help: Counted for you from the first and last day of leave, both days included.

slots.label: Qualification being acquired
slots.help: Plain words for the course or qualification.

slots.label: Place of study
slots.help: Where the study leave is spent.

slots.label: Service liability, years
slots.help: The whole years of mandatory service the approval letter names.

slots.label: Service liability, months
slots.help: The months of mandatory service that go with those years.

slots.label: Letter approving the leave
slots.help: The number and date of the IHQ of MoD (Army) or DGAFMS letter that approved it, quoted as the authority. Leave blank if you do not have it yet.

templates.authority: IHQ of MoD (Army)/DGAFMS letter No {letter.no} dated {letter.date}

slots.label: Annual leave already taken this year
slots.help: Days of annual leave already availed, extended, saved for encashment or set against sick leave this year. Only the 60-day check reads it; it is not printed.

slots.label: Retirement or release date
slots.help: Only if you retire or are released this year: the date. Only the 60-day check reads it; it is not printed.

slots.label: Order that granted the study leave
slots.help: The published Part II order that granted the study leave. Leave blank if it is not out yet; the slip prints a blank to fill in.
